payload.text: Measured 2026-11-06: `git remote -v` lists a third remote beside local and upstream, and its main is an ancestor of Intent's main, so it has taken Intent's main before. bin/.devbin/config.yaml declares repo but no release.remotes, and its comment still says this checkout has two remotes; devbin's release core pushes to every listed remote when none is declared (cc's source read, 2026-10-23). So the first cut through the core (ST0091) would push to the third remote too. Which remotes a cut pushes to is hv's to say before that cut; decision 90's push names local and upstream.
